ruling.recommended_action: Issued as Ryde voucher ($3.39, NS-7) for 2.40 km of unexplained off-route meter distance; record driver's RD-1 shortest-route breach on file.

segment_findings.reason: Driver's approach to Tanjong Pagar Centre 22:39–22:45 (peak 0.73 km from pickup, returning to 1.2766,103.8459) is pre-pickup dead mileage on an unmetered vehicle, outside the trip metre segment; not part of the fare.

~22:51–22:54: driver ran Telok Blangah/Keppel service roads parallel to ECP instead of the quoted ECP link (0.78 km expected vs 1.26 km driven, ~0.5 km extra). No rider-requested stop (RD-3), no prior agreement (RD-5), and no traffic incident or band 1/2 record (RD-4); unexplained deviation, RD-1 breach, counted under RD-2.

~22:56–23:04: driver cut inland through Keppel Rd/Anson (to ~1.3014,103.8879) instead of staying on the quoted ECP alignment, ~1.9 km extra. Driver's 'GPS rerouted me' claim has no traffic corroboration (RD-4 requires an incident on the replaced optimal segment; only a band-3 record exists), so not exempt; counted under RD-2.

rejected_claims.reason: Claim that the GPS reroute justified the deviation: no traffic incident and only a light (band 3) speed record on the quoted route, so RD-4 is not satisfied; GPS trace shows the deviations were driver-chosen service-road shortcuts, and system records override the driver's statement.

Rider's '25 km' figure matches the metre's 24.94 km, but only 2.40 km is attributable to un-exempt off-route segments; the rest is driver approach dead mileage and matching residue plus the quoted-route baseline, which are not refundable under RD-2.
